system.description:
Phase Breach: Make an Interface Roll
(13). Once per rest on a success, you
and all creatures touching you can pass
through a wall or door within Close
range by using a phase module,
molecular bypass, breach field, or
emergency matter-shift route. The
effect ends once everyone is on the
other side.
Blacksite Gate: Make an Interface Roll
(14). Once per long rest on a success,
open a gateway to a sealed facility,
hidden network layer, deep bunker, off-
grid safehouse, restricted blacksite, or
strange space you've been to before.
This gateway lasts until your next rest.
